svg.text: SCALE 1:1 · W SCHEMATIC · SEVEN SINGLE-LINE ROWS
ROW OUTLINES ARE CONSTRUCTION LINES ONLY.
DEPTH INDENTS TEXT; RAIL STAYS STRAIGHT.
D = LEVEL − MINIMUM LEVEL; DEFAULT LEVEL IS 2.
SPAN COVERS VISIBLE ROWS; SINGLE PICKS ONE.
BETWEEN HEADINGS, THE LAST PASSED ROW WINS.
WIDTH AND MAXIMUM HEIGHT BELONG TO CALLER.
OVERFLOW-Y AUTO; X CLIPPED; SCROLLBAR HIDDEN.
HOVER LABELS KEEP THEIR LAYOUT BOXES.
POINTER, KEYBOARD FOCUS OR TOUCH REVEAL THEM.
NO CONTAINER FILL, BORDER, SHADOW OR RADIUS.
NO COLLAPSE; ROW AND MARKER MEASUREMENTS STAY VALID.
H1 = 2·S5 + N·L1. N IS THE WRAPPED LINE COUNT.
ANCHOR FILLS ITS LI; NO FIXED HEIGHT OR ELLIPSIS.
EDGE SPACE P1 / P2 ONLY WHEN OVERFLOWING.
ACTIVE RANGE CENTRES; OVERSIZED RANGE LEADS.
FIRST / LAST RANGE REACHES SCROLL ENDPOINT.
AXONOMETRIC · LAYER GAPS NOT TO SCALE
OFFSET / HEIGHT INPUTS ARE INTEGER DOM MEASUREMENTS.
REDUCED MOTION: CSS 1ms; JS SCROLLS IMMEDIATELY.
SOURCE: registry/ui/table-of-contents + shared scroll / tracking helpers; app/globals.css.
